# Gavel V2 testnet addresses

<!-- Generated by script/v2-addresses/generate.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Gavel V2 on **Arbitrum Sepolia** (chain id 421614). These contracts are deployed for testing and are **not audited**. The tokens are test tokens with no value. Each address links to Arbiscan. Every contract in this list other than the test tokens has verified source there. A machine-readable copy is in [`v2-testnet-addresses.json`](v2-testnet-addresses.json).

Every owned contract on the testnet is owned by the account that deployed it; `owner()` returns it.

How these contracts work: [Gavel developer docs](https://github.com/JamieFrame/gavel-developer-docs/tree/main/v2).
